purpose: Make the Legacy independent-candidate and synchronized-commit behavior executable without linking Legacy into product or reference probes.

provenance.notes: The Python comparator verifies the frozen archive, two raw source entries, the recorded passing Legacy CTest and the exact input bytes. Decimal analysis and the isolated C++17 journal probe independently exercise the distinguishing case.

expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Event identity, multiplicity and candidate-before-commit partial order are exact.

expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Synthetic scalar results use absolute tolerance 1e-12; the early-commit discriminator must remain nonzero.

expected_facts.claim: The observation is tied to the frozen Legacy archive, simulator and test entries, and a passing recorded runtime test.

acceptance: Verifies frozen source and runtime-test evidence before comparing behavior
